messages:
maya: heads up — saw available H100 slots in dedicated-us-west2 dip from ~42 -> 9 over the last 30m, scheduler kept routing requests to shared pools which spiked tail p99s :frowning:
infra-bot: [alert] pool=dedicated-us-west2-h100 capacity=9/120 (7.5%) | pending_jobs=24 | recent_evictions=3
kevin: did we just lose capacity or is this mis-reporting? any recent maintenance?
arnold: no manual maintenance on that AZ. checking node-level telemetry now. early suspicion: slot-churn from preemptible reclaim + autoscaler overshot removal.
maya: logs show a flurry of preemptible reclaim events at 14:12UTC, but the autoscaler reconciliation loop marked nodes as drained and removed them from pool state. however pool inventory didn't reflect re-attach from warm-pool.
kevin: can you run the pool describe? put output here.
arnold: ran: `redwoodctl pool describe --name dedicated-us-west2-h100 --output json` -> shows `available_slots: 9`, `attached_warm: 0`, `last_reattach: null`, `slot_watermark: -1`
arnold: also saw many `alloc-watermark` updates failing with 504 from inventory service in logs between 14:10-14:18.
maya: that inventory 504 window aligns with CDN outage earlier — if inventory writes failed, scheduler may have fallen back to soft-routing rules and avoided the dedicated pool
tia: cost note — falling back to shared doubles per-token unit costs for some heavy workloads; we hit cost alert band in billing scrub for the cluster
kevin: ok action plan: 1) force warm-pool reattach for the dedicated pool 2) investigate inventory write TTL and retry logic 3) add cross-check so scheduler doesn't route away from dedicated if recent detach looks like transient
maya: I'll trigger the reattach now: `redwoodctl pool warm-attach --pool dedicated-us-west2-h100 --count 20` — will monitor
infra-bot: job queued: warm-attach id=wa-20230415-991 | expected-complete ~10m
arnold: filing infra ticket for inventory 504 -> retry/backoff gap, tagging storage and proxy teams, ref: INF-3421
tia: also recommend a quick mitigation: add a temporary routing bias for `enterprise-dedicated` customers so they stay pinned during inventory blips
kevin: agree. let's avoid long-lived cost regressions. maya ping when warm-attach done and paste `redwoodctl pool describe` output again
maya: warm-attach succeeded, attached 18 slots. pool shows available_slots=27. I'll leave a watch for 20m and then we can decide on longer-term fixes
arnold: confirmed p99 latencies dropped back under SLO after reattach. leaving issue open for root-cause & retry hardening
kevin: nice work. backlog items: INF-3421 (inventory retry), INF-3422 (scheduler fallback bias), INF-3423 (billing alert sensitivity). assigning today.
maya: thanks — will update ticket with precise timestamps and logs. :thumbsup:
